title: Hormuz event count leads FRO volatility
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Hormuz GKG news share 20d z-score > 1.5 leads FRO absolute returns (volatility) by 1 day (+); trade long FRO straddle proxy 2d [gdelt.gkg.hormuz_share -> finance.FRO.abs_return] (parent: R2-0001)
message: Indicator swapped once (events.hormuz.count n=11 -> gdelt.gkg.hormuz_share). r=-0.017 n=390 perm_p=0.52: no lead-lag signal. Trade rule: 5 trades, hit 1.0 but excess vs baseline only +0.05pp; actionability 9.1 is inflated because the target abs_return is non-negative (long vol proxy always wins). Verdict: noise, not a rule.

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.hormuz_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long FRO next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] CONTROL: Hormuz GKG news share 20d z-score > 1.5 leads FRO signed log returns by 1-3 days (+) - tests whether the abs_return vol result is directional or an artifact of a non-negative target; trade long FRO 3d [gdelt.gkg.hormuz_share -> finance.FRO.log_return] (parent: R2-0101)
